findings.title: Lightness for $primary branch inverted from 70% to 30%
findings.body: The conversion changed the primary branch's lightness from 70% to 30%, swapping the original and the complementary value. The light theme now renders .custom-message-length with the primary color at 30% lightness (dark/muted gray) instead of the intended 70% (light). Other files in this PR correctly preserve the original primary lightness and only add the secondary branch (e.g., admin_base.scss .badges .current-badge p.help keeps 40% on the primary branch). The expected fix is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: Primary branch lightness swapped (30% became 70%)
findings.body: In .embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a, the primary branch's lightness was changed from 30% to 70%, inverting the original color. In the light theme this link is now a much lighter shade than before. The pattern used by other files in this PR keeps the primary branch lightness equal to the original `scale-color($primary, $lightness: ...)` value; only the secondary branch is added. Expected: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The companion `.arrow` rule at line 294 is converted correctly (60% / 40%).

findings.title: .group-member-info .name lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: Original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`; the new value is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The primary branch lightness was changed during the edit, so the light theme renders the user name at 50% lightness (mid-gray) instead of 30% (dark text). Either the primary should remain 30% with secondary at 70%, or the surrounding .title rule should also have been updated; as-is the two sibling rules share the same color in the light theme when they used to differ.

findings.title: .group-member-info .name lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: Same defect as the desktop counterpart: original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`; the new value is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. Primary branch lightness was altered, regressing the light-theme color for group-member names. Should be 30% on the primary branch and 70% on the secondary branch, matching the original intensity.

findings.title: .topic-map h3 lightness changed from 20% to 50%
findings.body: Original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` (very dark, near-black title); the new value is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The primary branch lightness was changed from 20% to 50%, so the light-theme topic-map section headers now render at mid-gray instead of near-black. The desktop equivalent at desktop/topic-post.scss line 321 correctly preserves 20% on the primary branch (`... $primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%)`). Expected fix here is the same shape: keep 20% on the primary branch.
